# Forge
> Forge is the engineering control layer for AI-assisted development. Contracts, decisions, workflows, and verification that stay with the project.
> For complete documentation in a single file, see [llms-full.txt](https://forge.warpgogol.com/llms-full.txt).
> Machine-readable Agent Surface (structured knowledge + capabilities): [agent.json](https://forge.warpgogol.com/.well-known/agent.json).
> API discovery catalog (RFC 9727): [api-catalog](https://forge.warpgogol.com/.well-known/api-catalog).
> OpenAPI 3.1 specification: [agent.openapi.json](https://forge.warpgogol.com/.well-known/agent.openapi.json).

## Primary sources
- [AI can write the code. Forge keeps the project engineered](https://forge.warpgogol.com/): Engineering rules stay with the project — regardless of which agent, model, or IDE you use
